name: Morningscore
description_en:
Morningscore combines Google keyword tracking, backlink research, on-page checks and guided SEO tasks with AI visibility monitoring. Its workflow connects a selected website and comparison set to research, monitored terms, Health findings and Missions; optional WordPress and Shopify tools can apply changes to a website.

The key evaluation question is which observation or action produced a result. A monetary SEO Score, a sampled GEO Score, an AI readiness report and a completed repair describe different things. Review their inputs, dates and website effects separately before treating a dashboard improvement as a business outcome.
description_zh:
Morningscore 将 Google 关键词跟踪、外链研究、页面检查及引导式 SEO 任务与 AI 可见度监测结合。流程把选定网站及比较对象接入研究、跟踪词、Health 问题和 Missions；可选 WordPress 与 Shopify 工具能把改动应用到网站。

评估关键是确定结果来自何种观测或动作。金额形式的 SEO Score、抽样 GEO Score、AI 就绪报告及已完成修复描述不同事情。应分别核对输入、日期与网站效果，再判断仪表盘改善是否对应业务结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Research terms and a deliberately selected daily tracking set are separate views.
core_features.explanation_zh: 研究词与主动选定的每日跟踪集合是不同视图。

core_features.explanation_en: GEO compares a website and its competitors on the website’s chosen prompt panel.
core_features.explanation_zh: GEO 以该网站选出的提示词集合比较本身及竞品。

core_features.explanation_en: Page findings feed investigation and suggested or custom Missions; completion frees active-task capacity.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面问题用于调查及建议／自定 Missions；完成任务释放活动容量。

core_features.explanation_en: Optional WordPress and Shopify connections can turn selected generated fixes into website changes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选 WordPress 与 Shopify 连接可将选定生成修复变为网站改动。

en: Select daily Google terms while keeping discovery work separate.
Investigate a Health finding, apply a reviewed repair and re-scan the affected page.
Compare a fixed AI prompt panel and inspect underlying answers before making content decisions.
zh: 选每日 Google 跟踪词，同时区分探索研究。
调查 Health 问题、应用审过修复并重扫相关页。
比较固定 AI 提示词集合，查原回答后再作内容决策。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Select a website, country, competitor set and a narrow evaluation question.
steps.zh: 选网站、国家、竞品集合及具体评估问题。

steps.en: Record dates and compare one tracked term, prompt and Health page.
steps.zh: 记日期，比一个跟踪词、提示词及 Health 页面。

steps.en: Review any generated repair before enabling CMS writes.
steps.zh: 启用 CMS 写入前审生成修复。

steps.en: Check report/export entitlement, role scope and an exit copy of required data.
steps.zh: 核报告／导出权限、角色范围及退出所需数据副本。

items.en: GEO is a selected, approximate prompt-panel indicator; inspect its actual refresh schedule.
items.zh: GEO 为选定提示词集合的近似指标，须核实际刷新周期。

items.en: AI fixes consume credits; generation, application and verification are different steps.
items.zh: AI 修复消耗额度，生成、应用与核查是不同步骤。

items.en: Scan scope and full/quick-scan allowances must be checked before a recurring crawl.
items.zh: 定时抓取前须核范围及全站／快速扫描额度。

items.en: API rate and release statements conflict across official surfaces; actual behavior is untested.
items.zh: 不同官方页面的 API 限流／发布状态冲突，未测试真实行为。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The public monthly table lists Lite $69, Business $99, Pro $159 and Premium $299. Respective allowances are2/4/10/20 users,3/10/30/100 sites,100/500/2000/5000 tracked keywords and100/1000/5000/20000 AI credits. Full scans/month:5/15/50/50; quick scans:100/1000/5000/5000; page caps:250/5000/25000/25000. Health scheduling/CSV begin at Business, link CSV at Pro. Full reports exclude Lite; ongoing reports require Pro+. Trial:14days, no card; not permanent free access. Annual pricing advertises two months free, but exact annual invoice and tax were not established. Upgrade is immediate with unused-time balance; downgrade timing unspecified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 公开月付表列 Lite $69、Business $99、Pro $159、Premium $299；依次含2/4/10/20用户、3/10/30/100网站、100/500/2000/5000跟踪词、100/1000/5000/20000 AI credits。每月全站扫描5/15/50/50、快速扫描100/1000/5000/5000、页面上限250/5000/25000/25000。Health 计划／CSV 从 Business、外链 CSV 从 Pro 起；Lite 无完整报告，持续报告需 Pro+。14天免卡试用，不等于永久免费。年付宣传免两个月，未确定准确年账单及税。升级立即生效并抵未用时间余额；降级生效时间未明。

faq.question_en: Does the score show actual sales?
faq.answer_en: No. SEO Score estimates monthly ad-equivalent value; GEO Score summarizes a sampled visibility panel. Neither is a sales ledger.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。SEO Score 估每月广告等值，GEO Score 汇总抽样可见度；两者都不是销售台账。

faq.question_en: Does an XML whitelist restrict the scan on its own?
faq.question_zh: XML 白名单独自限制扫描范围吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The guide says it adds listed pages; only-list scanning additionally needs the crawler-specific robots restriction.
faq.answer_zh: 不。指南称其增加所列页；只扫所列页还需爬虫专属 robots 限制。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Start with a website, a comparison set and a question
sections.title_zh: 从网站、比较集合与问题开始
sections.en: The introductory guide separates Research’s discovered keywords and Website Lookup from Tracking’s selected terms. Lookup can inspect another site without saving it as a competitor. Editorial evaluation: choose one site and market, identify the decisions that need repeat monitoring, and keep exploratory ideas out of the tracking list until they matter. Record the comparison set before judging relative movement. This is a documentation-based evaluation path, not evidence that an account was created or a site connected.
sections.zh: 入门指南区分 Research 发现词／Website Lookup 与 Tracking 选定词。Lookup 可查看其他网站而不保存为竞品。编辑评估：选一个网站和市场，确定哪些决策需重复监测；探索点子有实际用途后再入跟踪表。判断相对变化前记录比较对象。本路径依据文档，未创建账户或连接网站。

sections.title_en: A dollar-valued SEO Score is an estimate of ad-equivalent value
sections.title_zh: 金额形式的 SEO Score 估计广告等值
sections.en: The metric combines search volume and expected click-through rate into estimated traffic, then uses cost-per-click to express a monthly paid-ad equivalent. It was previously named Morningscore. It is not a record of sales, profit or the account’s advertising bill. Editorial interpretation: compare a consistent country, keyword basis and date range, then verify actual acquisition or conversion questions in the relevant first-party reporting. A larger score can indicate a changed ranking/input model without proving that more paying customers arrived.
sections.zh: 此指标结合搜索量与预期点击率估计流量，再按点击单价表达每月付费广告等值，旧名为 Morningscore。它不是销售、利润或账户广告账单。编辑读法：保持国家、关键词基础与期间一致比较，再到相关第一方报表核实际获客／转化问题。分数增长可能来自排名或输入模型变化，不能证明付费客户增加。

sections.title_en: The prompt panel defines what GEO Score measures
sections.title_zh: 提示词集合决定 GEO Score 测量范围
sections.en: The GEO guide describes selecting about100 prompts from the site crawl and its top200 SEO-weighted keywords, then looking them up in ChatGPT in the chosen country. Answer presence scores100%, source-only presence20%, absence0%; the guide does not formalize every aggregation detail. Saved competitors use this site’s prompts. The pool is refreshed monthly, roughly three prompts per day; custom tracked prompts are weekly. The vendor calls this an approximate indicator. Editorial analysis: inspect the underlying prompt and answer before interpreting movement; a daily graph is not evidence that every prompt was freshly observed that day, nor a population measure of all ChatGPT users.
sections.zh: GEO 指南称按网站抓取及 SEO 权重最高的约200词选约100提示词，在所选国家查询 ChatGPT。回答中出现计100%，仅来源出现20%，均无则0%；指南未形式化全部汇总细节。已存竞品也用本网站提示词。默认池按月刷新、约每日三词；自选跟踪词每周刷新。厂商明确称其为近似指标。编辑分析：先看具体提示词及回答，再解释变化；每日图表不证明当日全词重测，也不是全部 ChatGPT 用户的总体测量。

sections.title_en: Read the observation date for each data type
sections.title_zh: 按数据类型读观测日期
sections.en: The freshness guide says daily overall scores do not mean daily positions for every discovered keyword: untracked terms are prioritized, and smaller sites may get full monthly updates. Selected Google terms update daily, with a documented24-hour manual-refresh cooldown; links update daily or through a manually added link. Health refreshes on scans. Its ChatGPT manual scan is still described as Coming soon in the dated guide, so availability was not assumed. Editorial checks: compare the row’s latest observation with the reporting period and avoid treating an unchanged old observation as a newly confirmed rank.
sections.zh: 新鲜度指南称总分每日更新不等于全部发现词每日更新位置：未跟踪词按优先级刷新，小网站可能按月完整更新。已选 Google 词每日更新，文档给手动刷新24小时冷却；外链每日或手动加链时刷新。Health 随扫描刷新。旧指南仍把 ChatGPT 手动扫描写为 Coming soon，未假定已可用。编辑核查：将行的最新观测与报告期间比较，避免把未变化旧观测当作新确认排名。

sections.title_en: Choose full-site, page-level or scheduled rechecks deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确选择全站、单页或定时复查
sections.en: Health offers a full-site Scan and an individual Scan landing page from the page menu. Weekly scheduling selects a weekday, and each scheduled run consumes a full scan credit. The pricing table also meters quick scans, so the older refresh guide’s individual-page workaround is not an unlimited-scanning entitlement. After applying a fix, inspect the live page, clear the relevant cache if stale and re-scan the affected scope. A pending old Health finding does not by itself prove the edit failed; a completed scan is also not a search-engine ranking guarantee.
sections.zh: Health 提供全站 Scan 及页面菜单的 Scan landing page。每周计划选择星期，每次消耗一次全站扫描额度。价格表同时限制 quick scans，因此旧刷新指南的单页变通不等于无限扫描权。修复后读真实页面，缓存过期时清相关缓存，再重扫对应范围。旧 Health 问题仍在不一定证明编辑失败；扫描完成也不保证搜索引擎排名。

sections.title_en: An XML whitelist adds pages unless crawl scope is restricted too
sections.title_zh: XML 白名单默认加页，限制范围还需抓取规则
sections.en: The Health guide supports rules specifically for Morningscore Bot. Its alternative root-level morningscore_whitelist.xml contains full page URLs and is read at the start of a scan. By default those pages are included in addition to the rest of the site. The newer whitelist guide says scanning only the listed pages also requires the crawler-specific robots restriction; the whitelist then provides exceptions. Editorial preparation: check the exact public file and intended scope before starting a scan, and distinguish this crawler’s rules from Google’s access. No site rules were changed here.
sections.zh: Health 指南支持针对 Morningscore Bot 的规则。另一方式是在网站根部放 morningscore_whitelist.xml，列完整页面 URL，扫描开始时读取。默认是在网站其余页面之外增加这些页面。较新白名单指南称若只扫所列页，还需该爬虫专属 robots 限制，再由白名单提供例外。编辑准备：启动前核公开文件及预期范围，区分该爬虫与 Google 的访问规则。本研究未改任何网站规则。

sections.title_en: Use Missions to close a task, not to certify business growth
sections.title_zh: 用 Missions 完成任务，不把它当业务增长认证
sections.en: Missions includes suggested and custom work, while completed work earns XP. The active limit is simultaneous capacity: completing a mission lets the user add another up to the plan limit. Editorial task design: select a concrete page or query problem, define the intended change and a matching recheck, then close the task when that evidence is available. Keep the operational completion separate from later traffic, revenue or AI visibility changes; XP is the application’s progress signal, not an independently measured commercial outcome.
sections.zh: Missions 包含建议及自定工作，完成可得 XP。活动上限是同时容量：完成后可按套餐上限补新任务。编辑任务设计：选具体页面／查询问题，定义改动与匹配复查，取得证据后完成任务。操作完成应与以后流量、收入或 AI 可见度变化分开；XP 是应用进度信号，不是独立测得的商业成效。

sections.title_en: WordPress can approve fixes first or apply them automatically
sections.title_zh: WordPress 可先审修复，也可自动应用
sections.en: The WordPress product guide describes Manual mode for approval before application and Automatic mode for immediate application followed by review/editing in Fixes. It describes frontend filters backed by the site’s database, with a JavaScript fallback for image alt tags, and warns that non-standard themes can prevent full application. Generating a supported fix consumes an AI credit per issue. Editorial evaluation: start with a small page set in Manual mode, inspect the rendered result and retain a recovery plan before broad automatic edits. No plugin, theme compatibility or recovery operation was tested.
sections.zh: WordPress 产品指南描述 Manual 先审后应用，Automatic 立即应用、以后在 Fixes 审查／编辑。它描述由网站数据库支持的前端过滤器，并为图片 alt 提供 JavaScript 后备；非标准主题可能使修复未完整应用。每个受支持问题生成修复消耗一个 AI credit。编辑评估：先用少量页面及 Manual，核实际呈现并备恢复方案，再扩自动编辑。未测试插件、主题兼容或恢复操作。

sections.title_en: Shopify writes native store records and documents rollback
sections.title_zh: Shopify 写入商店记录并提供文档化回退
sections.en: The Shopify guide describes an externally hosted app using OAuth and the Shopify GraphQL Admin API. It retrieves Health issues, generates fixes and queues writes to supported products, collections, articles and image alt data. Before/after values support documented per-fix or session rollback; processing is capped at5000 issues per scan. Changes are native store data and can persist after the subscription ends. Editorial acceptance: check the changed record and public HTML, investigate caching or theme differences, and verify rollback on a small sample before bulk use. These are documented capabilities, not observed successful store writes.
sections.zh: Shopify 指南描述外部托管应用，使用 OAuth 及 Shopify GraphQL Admin API。它取 Health 问题、生成修复并排队写受支持商品、集合、文章及图片 alt。前后值用于文档所述逐条／整批回退，每次扫描最多处理5000问题。变化属于商店原生数据，可在订阅结束后保留。编辑验收：核记录与公开 HTML、查缓存或主题差异，大批量使用前用小样本验回退。以上为文档能力，未观察真实商店成功写入。

sections.title_en: GEO Health recommendations and GEO Score observations are different outputs
sections.title_zh: GEO Health 建议与 GEO Score 观测是不同输出
sections.en: The July2026 release introduces Health → GEO Health → Generate for a report of AI visibility recommendations. It also adds custom instructions to Page Booster in the WordPress/Shopify tools. A generated readiness checklist is not the same measurement as the sampled prompt score, and an optimization proposal is not proof that an AI engine cited the changed page. Editorial sequence: inspect the recommendation’s relevance, approve a specific content change, read back the implementation and compare later observations under the same prompt configuration.
sections.zh: 2026年7月版本说明提供 Health → GEO Health → Generate，生成 AI 可见度建议报告，并在 WordPress／Shopify Page Booster 增加自定指令。就绪检查表与抽样提示词分数不是同一测量，优化建议也不证明 AI 引擎引用了改后页面。编辑顺序：审建议是否适用，采用具体内容改动，读回实现，再用相同提示词配置比后续观测。

sections.title_en: A subaccount transfers capacity rather than creating an extra pool
sections.title_zh: 子账户转移容量，不增加额度池
sections.en: Invite users through Settings → Users with a role and email. The role guide permits multiple Owners with billing and user-management powers, including removing another Owner. Editors can work within restricted website access and creation limits but cannot use Users, Subscription or Email reports settings. Guests are read-only with configurable website scope. A Subaccount has one user and its own visible sites; the parent Owner can access it. Allocated keyword and website credits are transferred out of the parent allowance. Editorial permissions review: test the intended website boundary with a limited role before sharing a client workspace.
sections.zh: 通过 Settings → Users 按邮箱及角色邀请。角色指南允许多个 Owner，拥有账单及用户管理权，包括删除其他 Owner。Editor 可设网站访问／新增限制，但不能用 Users、Subscription、Email reports 设置。Guest 只读、可限网站。Subaccount 只有一个用户，仅见自身网站，父 Owner 可访问；分给它的关键词／网站额度从父账户转走。编辑权限核查：交付客户工作区前，用受限角色验证预期网站边界。

sections.title_en: Schedule a report only after checking the plan’s delivery allowance
sections.title_zh: 先核套餐交付额度，再排报告
sections.en: The reporting guide creates an ongoing report by choosing a template, the Ongoing schedule and a frequency. Current plan comparison reserves ongoing reports for Pro and Premium; a general scheduling guide does not override entitlement. Health exports and link exports also start at different tiers. Editorial reporting handoff: record the period, source freshness and included sections, inspect the recipient-facing output, and confirm any sharing/privacy controls before client delivery. Immutable snapshots, password protection, exact delivery timezone and a full account export were not verified.
sections.zh: 报告指南通过选模板、Ongoing 及频率建持续报告。当前套餐表仅 Pro／Premium 有持续报告，通用指南不覆盖套餐权。Health 与外链导出也从不同档位开始。编辑交接：记期间、来源新鲜度及模块，审接收方输出，交客户前确认共享／隐私控制。未核不可变快照、密码保护、准确投递时区或全账户导出。

sections.title_en: The rendered API reference is newer than some marketing promises
sections.title_zh: 渲染的 API 参考已超出部分营销页描述
sections.en: The public reference lists read and write groups, including competitor changes, mission lifecycle, GEO, GEO Health, Writer and Page Booster. Its introduction requires a dashboard API key and shows Bearer authentication; it states20 requests/second with100 in a rolling5-second window. The product page still says2/second and marks AI access upcoming. The reference also describes a beta OAuth-based MCP endpoint. Editorial integration planning: confirm current endpoint entitlement, effective limits and mutation scopes before executing requests; protect credentials and use the smallest useful test. This research read documentation only and cannot resolve actual enforcement or certify an integration.
sections.zh: 公开参考列出读写组，含竞品修改、任务生命周期、GEO、GEO Health、Writer、Page Booster。介绍要求仪表盘 API key 并显示 Bearer 认证，写每秒20次及滚动5秒100次。产品页仍写每秒2次，且 AI 访问待推出。参考还描述基于 OAuth 的 beta MCP 端点。编辑集成规划：执行前确认端点权、真实限流及修改范围，保护凭据，用最小有效测试。此处仅读文档，不能解决实际限流或认证集成。

sections.title_en: Cancellation and account deletion are different exit steps
sections.title_zh: 取消订阅与删账户是不同退出动作
sections.en: Cancellation is under Settings → Subscription and preserves fresh-data access until the prepaid period ends. The help article says the account will be deleted at a future date without specifying when; annual plans commit for12months according to pricing. A separate older guide documents an explicit account-deletion confirmation. Editorial exit plan: save needed reports and data while access remains, and obtain written clarification of retention or restoration needs before cancellation/deletion. Neither an indefinite archive nor recovery after deletion was established. Native Shopify edits persisting in a store do not imply continued access to Morningscore’s history.
sections.zh: 取消在 Settings → Subscription，保留预付期间内新数据访问。帮助文称以后会删账户，但未说何时；价格页称年付承诺12个月。另一旧指南另述明确删账户确认。编辑退出计划：可访问时保存所需数据／报告，取消／删除前确认保留或恢复需求。未确定无限归档或删除后恢复。Shopify 原生编辑继续存在不代表仍可读 Morningscore 历史。

seo.title_en: Morningscore: SEO, GEO, scans and CMS repair workflows
seo.title_zh: Morningscore：SEO、GEO、扫描及 CMS 修复流程
seo.description_en: Research Morningscore scores, prompt refresh, crawl scope, CMS writes, roles and plan limits from official documentation.
seo.description_zh: 按官方文档研究 Morningscore 分数、提示词刷新、抓取范围、CMS 写入、角色及套餐限制。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Morningscore for a documented monitoring and repair workflow
secondary_questions: How often is GEO Score refreshed?
What does the XML whitelist include?
How do WordPress and Shopify fixes differ?
Which report and export features require a higher plan?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Actual account permissions, CMS compatibility, generated-fix quality, rollback success and API rate enforcement were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测账户权限、CMS 兼容、生成修复质量、回退成功或 API 限流。

research_gaps.en: Exact GEO aggregation, prompt search-volume methodology, current manual ChatGPT refresh and regional/model coverage remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核准确 GEO 汇总、提示词搜索量方法、当前 ChatGPT 手动刷新及地区／模型覆盖。

research_gaps.en: Post-cancellation retention/deletion date, restoration, complete export, taxes, annual invoice and downgrade effective date remain unspecified.
research_gaps.zh: 取消后保留／删日期、恢复、完整导出、税、年账单及降级生效日未明确。

research_gaps.en: Application UI languages and an open-source license were not established from localized marketing/help pages.
research_gaps.zh: 未从营销／帮助页本地化推定应用界面语言或开源许可。
